parent_objective: Coalesce BetterInstincts with PR 271: continue the live Video Gaming certification by reusing completed evidence and preserving the open game. After reviewed closure, route to the oldest eligible disposable save for the same household. Persist explicit household preference when multiple choices exist, distinguish lab and protected play, and give the local agent a concrete handoff.
proposed_capability: Preload historical preference evidence for the running certification handoff and route an independently reviewed successor through a chosen household's attested disposable saves.
player_save_control_impact: Local preference never confers game input or save classification. The active certification game stays open until the actual current offer is reconciled and reviewed. Protected and unknown saves remain outside the automation path.
expected_outcome: Handoff loads existing historical outcomes before any action. The profile remembers an explicit household choice, ambiguity requires player input, and a separately bound successor trial ranks only verified disposable saves from the certification household.
negative_tests: Historical receipt must not complete a current offer.
Wrong household, stale preference, or failed same-household identity check must not route a different save.
Old unattested, protected and continuation saves are not successor targets.
No save load, restart or click from offline routing or profile preference.
rollback_path: Revert source and ontology changes together; local settings are user-owned and never reset, with optional profile field read only by the new source.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual Windows process, native observer, saved household and menu/load adapter evidence remain local and unobserved. Active PRs #261–263 own native preference work.
